scope: One synthetic actual-PPO software Vulkan correctness case; disabled cache, no timing/performance qualification

configuration.structural_route: actual compiled ActionPlanning→ActionPlanning LateralInhibition; exact route update cadence
configuration.selected_decoder_offset_in_dense_vector: selected decoder coordinate25728: 0.012 + 0.001*tick; only this coordinate is nonzero/changing in an otherwise-zero32768-entry vector

checks.source_reviews: Root and independent helper reviewed complete fixture before execution; no source blockers.

notes: Separate branch/worktree from exactb1; no PR225 head mutation or capacity implementation imported. Only one new test module and a module hook, plus evidence. Production code/shaders/device admission unchanged.

Dendritic outputs are computed from previous activations plus immutable descriptors; no separate dynamic branch register exists. Actual after-tick0 activation/EMA/metabolic state and unchanged descriptors seed the suffix. Every suffix row including burn-in is bit-compared.

Individual ablations use fixed explicit adjoints and prove direct GPU forward/BPTT effects. The additional normal PPO no-context control recollects its own GPU labels; its optimizer moment difference proves actual controller use.

Original execution is cleanb886. Later test-only lint idiom uses enumerate plus explicit six-value length assertion instead of fixed range, retaining all six equality checks. No repeated context test or performance assay.
Actual selector0/AdapterInfo identifies CPU llvmpipe Vulkan. No hardware/PC work or real checkpoint. Test wall time is correctness process context, not throughput evidence.
Memory-cap fallback, forced actor-apply/value rollback failure, physical GPU qualification, maximal dendritic topology and production activation remain unqualified.

Offset qualification covers only the selected decoder coordinate in an otherwise-zero dense storage vector; no broad active-offset or recurrent-offset coverage is claimed. Descriptive neuron/route labels are selected decoder source and actual ActionPlanning lateral-inhibition route.
